data.name: Nushur
data.gender_notes: Nushur is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘an-Nashora’, meaning ‘the one who restores’ or ‘the one who returns’. In Islamic history, this name is associated with the wife of Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him), who was known for her patience and perseverance. The name Nushur evokes feelings of peace, restoration, and renewal. The name Nushur carries the meaning “Rest, Return, Peace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nushur usually hope their child will grow to embody rest, return, peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of patience and perseverance in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Nushur belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rest, Return, Peace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nushur total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: نشر
in_arabic.meaning: نشر تعریف کرتا ہے کہاللہ تعالیٰ موت کے بعد لوگوں کو زندہ کرے گا
in_arabic.long_meaning: نشر (Nushur) کا مطلب ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ موت کے بعد لوگوں کو زندہ کرے گا، جیسا کہ قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہے۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا تعلق قیامت کے دن سے ہے جب اللہ تعالیٰ سب जीवوں کو دوبارہ زندہ کرے گا۔

in_urdu.name: نشر
in_urdu.meaning: نشر کا مطلب ہے موت کے بعد زندگی، اللہ تعالیٰ کی قدرت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نشر (Nushur) نام عربی زبان سے لیا گیا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے موت کے بعد زندگی یا اللہ تعالیٰ کی قدرت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں خاص اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر قیامت کے دن کے حوالے سے جب اللہ تعالیٰ تمام جانداروں کو دوبارہ زندہ کرے گا۔

in_hindi.name: नुशर
in_hindi.meaning: नुशर का अर्थ है परमेश्वर की शक्ति से जीवन प्राप्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: नुशर (Nushur) नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है परमेश्वर की शक्ति से जीवन प्राप्ति। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, खासकर कयामत के दिन के संदर्भ में जब अल্লাহ सभी जीवों को पुनः जीवित करेगा।

in_pashto.name: نشر
in_pashto.meaning: نشر دى دالله له لورى ژوند ورکول

in_english.name: Nushur
in_english.meaning: Resurrection, return to life through God's power
in_english.long_meaning: Nushur is an Arabic-originated name that signifies resurrection or return to life through God's power. It is derived from the Arabic root 'n-sh-r' which appears in the Quran, specifically referring to the Day of Judgment when God will resurrect all beings. The name holds significant spiritual and theological implications, symbolizing faith in divine power and the hereafter.
